Title: Disable Enemy Temporal Fugue
Description:
Performance optimization mod that prevents NPCs from using Temporal Fugue (time clones) while keeping it available for the player.

  • Reduces lag from multiple Temporal Fugue clones
  • Player can still use Temporal Fugue normally
  • Cleaner combat with fewer time clones
https://github.com/SattaRIP/caves-of-qud-disable-enemy-temporal-fugue

  • Safe to add to existing saves
  • Safe to remove
  • Compatible with other mods
  • Uses Harmony patching for reliability
